children: may retest resistance at $104.90 per barrel, a break above which could trigger gains into the $106.18-$107.41 range.
The contract stabilized above a rising trendline. The stabilization suggests the fall from $109.40 is complete, or that this is only the first part of it.
Either a good bounce has started, or the uptrend from $85.42 has resumed. A break below $102.96 may lead to a drop to $101.59. The fall could confirm an extension of the short downtrend from $109.40.

On the daily chart, the market remains within a rising channel. A long-shadowed hammer formed around the support at $102.67 on Thursday, further indicating the completion of the correction from $109.97.
The correction is expected to be the same degree as the one from $94.83. A break above $105.88 would signal the uptrend's continuation toward $110.24.
